name: Basis Transform for Trivariate Polynomials
definition: Transformation of polynomial basis from B-spline to scaled Bernstein or power basis to enable efficient root finding and composition. This avoids storing explicit descriptions of every single polynomial in memory.
summary: Basis Transform for Trivariate Polynomials converts B-spline coefficients to Bernstein or power bases on-the-fly, avoiding memory overhead by exploiting tensor product structure for efficient volume compositing.
